blocks.text: Possible origin. A human security or research worker discovers the Gate after players and chooses negotiated protection over containment, extraction, or denial.
Function. This role links Refusers, Custodians, and Human Reciprocity to Era Four while taking genuine security failure seriously.
Risk. The Custodian may become paternalistic, compromised, discredited, or replaced by a joint human–cyber-pet office.
